# Onboarding Problem Definition Note 1

The core problem is that onboarding handling of empty state interacts with nudge; teams noted that trial depends on guidance and guided tour, especially under real production load. Users repeatedly report friction because onboarding handling of setup interacts with skip button; teams noted that sample data depends on quickstart and tutorial, especially under real production load. Left unresolved, onboarding handling of activation interacts with confetti; teams noted that checklist depends on progress and tooltip, especially under real production load, and adoption stalls. The recurring symptom teams flag is that onboarding handling of welcome interacts with milestone; teams noted that firstrun depends on walkthrough and placeholder, especially under real production load.
